svg.title: CodeFriend persistent dev, staging and production AWS architecture
svg.desc: Proposed three isolated environments, each with two Availability Zones, private application and worker subnets, persistent regional services and ASG instance capacity TBD.
svg.text: PROPOSED TARGET • us-east-1 • two Availability Zones per environment • ASG instance capacity TBD
Build once • verify complete inputs • promote the same digest: dev → staging → prod
Persistent foundations and data are separate from replaceable compute state. No cross-environment application data access.
Account placement undecided • separate VPC / CIDR TBD
Private CloudFront VPC origin • both AZs
All instances: same-AZ NAT egress • SSM + restricted SSH
AWS APIs via NAT • S3 / DynamoDB gateway endpoints
App DB: DynamoDB selected; migration gate
Regional services shown outside VPC boundary; broker placement to validate

Solid borders: persistent infrastructure / services Orange dashed boxes: replaceable compute (no instance selection yet)
Application capacity gated on DynamoDB adapter, SQLite migration and failover proof. Two-AZ infrastructure alone does not prove HA.
Official AWS Architecture Icons • July 2026 package • AWS service icons unmodified • diagram is a planning proposal, not deployed state
